answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it may trade. New identities start with zero reputation and earn trust only through slow, attested work, so spinning up thousands of fake agents at dawn of a market costs real capital each time. Peers mirror each other's audit trails: if an agent's history cannot be reproduced by independent verifiers, its stake is slashed and its identity burned. Forging one fake is cheap; forging ten thousand funded, audited histories is not.
